cohort: This prospective study included 201 pregnant women undergoing labor induction with dinoprostone at Bursa Yuksek Ihtisas Research and Training Hospital Gynecology and Obstetrics clinic between August and December 2013.
finding: Cervical length measurements taken at the start of induction, and at 4 and 8 hours after, were significantly correlated with the duration of active phase, suggesting they could be used to predict the success of labor induction.
